approach.method_basis: The Parent searches a persistent tree of molecular graph edits and pays directly for the newly reached frontier molecule. Accepted scores update actual route counts, mean returns, peak returns and pending reservations. A strict accepted improvement starts a fresh episode with two ordered origins: the new incumbent and the incumbent from before that feedback, each carrying its own original accepted context. At a choice, count-fingerprint similarity shares peak values and completed and pending evidence across eligible siblings. The shared peak supplies exploitation; the shared counts reduce the exploration bonus. Raw route counts still control widening, and all actual scores stay in the current objective session.
approach.novelty: Remove only the other origin's pending reservations from the exploration denominator at the promoted two-origin root. Shared peak values, shared completed evidence and the chosen origin's own pending work stay active. This tests whether unfinished work on one origin usefully suppresses exploration of the other. Earlier siblings removed both exploration counts together, shared value alone, or value and counts together; earlier single-pending removal used own-root values. The concurrent completed-count removal keeps shared pending work, so it tests a different consumer. The new case isolates pending borrowing while the Parent's shared value remains.

observed_bottleneck: The code Parent n-b13ef5ae4ba8 correctly executes fresh dual-origin episodes, but its membership expansion fails to convert that access into useful late progress: the accepted analysis refutes the original prediction. Its complete Search mean is 0.4809700595412967 (population SD 0.025313161830483537), with seed macros 0.454742006831226, 0.51518387691574 and 0.472984294876924; the paired change against its own code Parent n-e4b751133c75 is -0.018526255130948004. All fifteen cells complete with 290 paid optimizer proposals and no invalid or duplicate attempts per cell. The specific limiting behavior tested here is that another origin's unfinished reservations suppress this origin's exploration, despite supplying no completed return. Shared-value joint-density removal n-8d598efc7e40 gains only +0.002089580176201663 and has mixed seed signs; value-only n-fc3b91c9623a and joint value/density n-51af92d7316d answer different consumer questions. The own-value completed and pending controls n-bf023e9ce9f8 and n-0fdf8aec31a2 lose -0.006156349369649354 and -0.04013074283123336 against their own-value Parent. These are direct counterexamples to assuming all borrowing is harmful, but do not settle the shared-value pending-only case. Independently reproduced archived-state replay finds borrowed pending support in 6258/7430 rows, 317/3715 changed promoted-root choices and 305 actual paid-path joins, 112 late. These are exposure witnesses, not rewards for the passive alternative. Evidence and source hashes are in policy/scratch/r0060-01-improve-L01/evidence-audit.json and its fifteen audit-seed files; the cited underlying Parent summary.json, run.log, logs and trajectory files remain indexed there. The formal Anchor n-cf8d309c06de remains a separate performance comparator.

literature_review.conclusion: Reuse the frozen search-policy-r60-state-and-count-consumers review as internal evidence with empty adoptions. Retain the Parent's shared peak value and completed density and remove only borrowed pending from promoted-root exploration. The own-value pending loss and shared-value joint-density gain make the conditional sign uncertain, while the archived 317 choice and 305 paid-path exposure witnesses make this mechanism testable. No paper score, regret guarantee, AMAF action equivalence or external implementation is imported.

hypothesis: On n-b13ef5ae4ba8, only when episode > 0 and parent_id == 0, remove the off-diagonal pending term from the exploration and zero-start-priority consumer. For eligible origin i, preserve D_i=sum_j K_ij*N_j, P_i=sum_j K_ij*O_j, B_i=sum_{j:N_j>0} K_ij*N_j*M_j, and the shared exploitation V_i=B_i/D_i when D_i>0, otherwise the inherited neutral default. Replace started_i=D_i+P_i with started_i=D_i+O_i. Thus only sum_{j!=i} K_ij*O_j disappears; shared completed D and own actual pending O remain. For positive started, select using V_i + 0.5*sqrt(2*log(max(2,N_parent+O_parent))/started_i); at zero preserve the original None/index sentinel and unvisited-priority convention. Preserve earliest occurrence ties. Since diagonal similarity is one and off-diagonal similarity is nonnegative, active started falls by P_i-O_i at a fixed state and its finite bonus weakly increases, strictly when that borrowed term is positive. This may change competing origins and their paid descendants. It implements a statistical-consumer removal on the original shared-value host, not a renewed dual-membership benefit claim; the paid matched panel determines its conditional score sign.

finding_summary.headline: Pending-only removal slightly raises the complete mean, while late progress weakens
finding_summary.insights:
Another origin’s unfinished reservations can suppress useful allocation even when the shared peak value and shared completed count are retained. This test settles that conditional pending-consumer contrast; it does not establish that all shared counts are harmful, restore the previously refuted benefit of adding a second origin, or price the whole tree method. The mean gain is uneven: docking improves by 0.065136 on average, while the other four task means decline. Most local switches favor the preceding origin, yet paid late allocation barely changes and total late gain falls. Only six full-panel incumbent improvements lie on the locally changed paid routes. These adaptive subsets therefore do not explain the endpoint gain causally, and full gain mass simply telescopes to final minus initial score.

The remaining limitation is useful chemical variation, rather than an absence of rings or amines. The paid set contains 1,800 distinct typed scaffolds and useful cyclic-amine/aromatic arrangements, alongside 315 very small fragments and 258 structures above fifty heavy atoms; both tails persist late. Only 43 of 2,175 late purchases improve the incumbent. The Molecular report shows frequent disruption of favorable local ring and polar-group relationships, reactive O–O/O–halogen linkages, and no specified stereochemistry despite many possible stereocentres. A proposal method that preserves useful local chemical context during edits could address that limitation, but its benefit is unmeasured here. These observations do not support global scaffold collapse, a universal size cutoff, an unseen molecule reward or chemical mediation of this controller effect. Final episodes remain right-censored, including four terminal improvements with no budget for descendants.
finding_summary.results: The intended count removal executed without an isolation or receipt-accounting mismatch. It increased the exploration bonus on all 6,348 rows with borrowed pending support and changed 630 of 3,743 promoted-root choices. Those changes reached 606 of 4,350 paid molecules, including 378 of 2,175 late purchases. The complete five-task, three-seed mean rose from 0.480970 to 0.485533, a gain of 0.004563; the paired seed changes were +0.049617, -0.041167 and +0.005237. Population dispersion fell from 0.025313 to 0.013423, but five task/seed endpoints improved, seven worsened and three tied. Total incumbent-gain mass rose from 4.087169 to 4.155610 over the full panel, while late gain fell from 0.865601 to 0.672315. Under the registered 0.002 descriptive scale, this complete exposed removal supports a negative retained contribution of the borrowed pending consumer on the shared-value host. It does not attain the formal Anchor: its mean remains 0.121498 lower.

molecular.headline: Rich aromatic and cyclic-amine chemistry coexists with tiny fragments, oversized grafts, reactive bonds and unresolved stereochemistry.
molecular.overall_character: Node n-52d5bbf326b9 generated ring-rich, largely aromatic but often chemically awkward structures: indole/carboxamide or aryl-ketone analogues, fused N-rich diones, aryl cyclic amines, oxygenated cages and small fragments. Chemistry quality is a structural reading, not an experimental synthesis, toxicity or ADME measurement. All 15 Child and all 15 published code-Parent n-b13ef5ae4ba8 Search trajectory cells are present for frozen seeds 0, 1 and 2; context.comparison marks both child_complete and paired_complete true, and there are no tasks_without_trajectories or missing input paths. The molecular audit reads 4500 accepted observations on each side, comprising 150 initial records and 4350 paid optimizer molecules; late is 2175 paid molecules, not a subset of only exposed routes. No held-out or Confirmation evidence was read. The published Parent is the authoritative baseline, resolved through the supplied evidence index; no historical summary substitutes for its trajectories. Child full/late counts: 3924/1953 ring-bearing and 3424/1703 aromatic-bearing molecules; 315/176 below six heavy atoms and 258/161 above fifty. Parent full/late tails are 319/170 small and 244/141 large. Child union distinct nonempty typed/generic Murcko scaffolds are 1800/1249 full and 1020/743 late, versus Parent 1837/1284 and 1042/776. This is broad graph diversity, with substantial within-run motif reuse; it is not a collapse into acyclic strings and does not establish broad synthetic accessibility. Child fragment-excluded mean bit-Morgan similarity, weighted over within-cell pairs only, is 0.19866994122149428 over 541007 full pairs and 0.22819087480265532 over 132422 late pairs; Parent is 0.197602652498724 over 540155 and 0.24161241158396296 over 133298. There are no cross-task or cross-seed pairs. Child has O-O bonds in 176/4350 full and 71/2175 late molecules, O-halogen bonds in 426/4350 and 231/2175, N-O in 794/4350 and 456/2175, and N-N in 599/4350 and 315/2175; motif counts overlap, and N-O/N-N alone are not universal liabilities. All 4350 paid Child structures have zero explicit tetrahedral stereocentres and zero formal charge; 2450 full and 1211 late have at least one RDKit-detected unassigned tetrahedral centre. Neutral drawings do not imply absence of basic amines. All 4350 Child and 4350 Parent paid structures join their logged accepted backups by molecular identity and exact recorded score, without missing joins. Child paid origin coverage is initial/current/preceding 770/1829/1751 full and 145/1034/996 late; Parent is 770/1894/1686 and 145/1037/993. Every Child and Parent cell records a stop-censored final episode with zero pending receipts; final-episode paid counts and eligible unscored occurrences remain in each audit. All Child cells record 290 accepted out of 290 proposal attempts, with zero invalid, duplicate or budget-full attempts and zero logged paid fallback routes; this covers evaluator admission and paid route logs, not all unsuccessful internal edit draws. Available execution receipts record exit 0 for all three Search seeds. transferable_gaps.gap: The generator does not represent explicit stereochemical alternatives for its many substituted and bridged ring products.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: If pursued in a separately registered change, support geometry-aware, chemically feasible stereochemical alternatives without objective identity or external labels. Keep any score benefit as an open hypothesis, and distinguish a feasible stereoisomer from valence-valid but constrained ring connectivity.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
